title: Count domains around a terminal-group center
statement:
Around C in H₂CO, how many electron domains are present and what is their parent geometry?

[_]{a}

explanations: This counts the double bond as two domains.
A three-domain parent arrangement is trigonal planar.

hints: The carbon neighbors are O and two H atoms.
The C=O double bond occupies one direction.
Carbon has no lone pair in the standard drawing.
solution: The carbon neighbors are O and two H atoms. The C=O double bond occupies one direction. Carbon has no lone pair in the standard drawing. There are three bonding directions.
